INDIA (LISTING OBLIGATIONS AND DISCLOSURE REQUIREMNETS) REGULATIONS, 2015 
(“LISTING REGULATIONS”) — SCHEDULE OF EARNING'’S CALL/ INVESTOR MEET 
Dear Sir/Madam, 
Pursuant to the provisions of Regulation 30 of the Listing Regulations read with Para A(15)(a) 
of Part A of Schedule Ill thereto, this is to inform you that Earnings Conference call for 
analyst/institutional investors will be held on Tuesday, 28" July, 2026 at 12.30 p.m. (IST) in 
respect of the Audited Financial Results (Standalone and Consolidated) of the Company for 
the Quarter and year ended 31 March, 2026, as per the details attached herewith. 
Please note that no Unpublished price Sensitive Information (UPSI) is proposed to be shared 
by the Company during the aforesaid investor meeting. 
The above disclosure is also being made available on the website of the Company at 
www.csm.tech 
This is for your information and records. 
Thanking you, 
For CSM Technologies Limited
